integrity: Proof plus finite standalone exact/numerical verification; finite checks are not a proof of all parameters. Related prior literature is acknowledged and one plausible historical paper was abstract-only.
scientific_limitations: Leading-order joint threshold accessibility for the small attracting periodic solution of the smooth continuation with thresholds moving toward coexistence; no Filippov crossing admissibility, tipping, fixed-threshold global claim, or all-amplitude law. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Three-regime joint threshold accessibility under weak periodic predator–prey forcing
